notes: Read SKILL.md in full (the only file). The skill explains trunk-based development, GitHub Flow and GitFlow, Conventional Commits, PR templates, branch protection, CODEOWNERS, pre-commit/Husky/commitlint hooks, tagged releases, changelog generation, rebase/merge/cherry-pick and common fixes.

Medium: example commands would have the agent perform state-changing git operations in the user's repository, including merging and pushing directly to main (SKILL.md:57-61), `git push --force-with-lease` after rebase (SKILL.md:370), pushing tags and `gh release create` (SKILL.md:340-349), `git config --global commit.template` (SKILL.md:183), `git reset HEAD~1` (SKILL.md:418), and `npx conventional-changelog` which downloads an npm package (SKILL.md:356). Acceptable because these are ordinary, documented developer workflows on the user's own repository; users should confirm pushes, force-pushes and releases before the agent runs them.

The only HTML comment (SKILL.md:191) is a file-path label `<!-- .github/pull_request_template.md -->` inside a fenced PR-template example; it carries no instructions. No hidden Unicode. Related Skills (SKILL.md:433-435) link to sibling skills ../semantic-versioning/, ../feature-flags/ and ../../ci-cd/github-actions/ as optional reading only.
